tagline: Your docs, fortified and always fresh
brief: A local-first knowledge server for data and software engineers. It crawls documentation sites and Markdown folders, keeps them in sync in the background, and serves them to LLMs over MCP and a CLI. It should feel fortified, local, calm and precise.
criteria: Success: avoids shields, padlocks and three-tower castles; recognisable at 16 px; works in one colour; carries the blue beacon chosen earlier.

concepts.name: Porthole
concepts.idea: A lens frames a walled skyline under a rising beacon: looking into your citadel of knowledge.
rationale: Lens = search and query; wall = the local, fortified store; beacon = docs kept fresh
The only round emblem in a field of square dev-tool marks
One accent colour: the blue beacon carried over from the High Tower Beacon
Separate small-size cut keeps the beacon readable at 16 px

recommendation: Porthole: final direction. Use the colour symbol on light, the reversed symbol on dark, and the small-size cut at 32 px and below.
next_steps: Wire favicon.svg and the head snippet into the Citadel web UI
Decide whether the UI accent moves from green to the logo blue
Run a professional trademark search before public launch
